Ravi: tiny celebration alert 1: we quietly crossed 75M tokens served this quarter. :sparkles: :confetti_ball:
Tessa: wait what?! that's huge. small party? kombucha or ramen truck? :ramen: :beers:
Noah: ramen truck wins every time. but i'm lobbying for neon shelfie photos and a one-line roast of my last PR. :camera_with_flash: :joy:
build-bot: CI: tests passed for release/2026-q1. artifact size unchanged.
ops-bot: Metric snapshot: tokens_qtr=75,002,113; avg_token_cost down 9% QoQ; incidents_qtr=1 (P2). Scaling worked during peak burst.
Ravi: plan: ramen truck at 1pm Thursday, neon sticker wall for selfies, and a 60s mic for "one tiny win" confessions. emoji RSVP: :ramen: means in-office ramen, :pizza: means remote care package.
Tessa: :ramen: I'll organize the sticker wall. also ordering reusable chopsticks.
Noah: :pizza: remote folks get a ramen voucher + neon sticker pack. can marketing do a short GIF?
Ravi: marketing pinged. Mei from growth will whip up a 6s neon GIF.
Tessa: also handwritten note idea: "75M tokens. thanks for batching, caching, and patience." small paper hearts optional.
Noah: add a tiny jab at my PR comment: "less yak-shaving, more yak-cuddling" :sweat_smile:
Ravi: agreed. photos afterward in #watercooler. keep it low-key and kind. thanks team 1 :heartpulse:

Tessa: perfect. see you all (and the ramen truck) on Thursday. :ramen:
